class.name: SteamModerationAuthorization
class.brief_description: A game policy's approval for one exact immutable moderation request.
class.description: Return an approval from [method SteamModerationPolicy._authorize] only after verifying the exact request. For a reviewed write, reserve a durable audit record before returning the approval. An approval for another request, an incorrect removal target, or a missing audit reference cannot authorize a sanction.

method.name: approve
method.description: Returns an approval bound to this exact [param request]. Use the reviewed [param player_id] for a suspension or ban. An empty player ID keeps the request's explicit target. A sanction or removal requires a durable [param audit_id]. Returns [code]null[/code] for a missing request.

method.name: get_player_id
method.description: Returns the policy's resolved target SteamID64 when the action addresses a player.

method.name: get_audit_id
method.description: Returns the trusted backend's durable audit reference for a reviewed action.

members.member: The policy's resolved target SteamID64 when the action addresses a player.
The trusted backend's durable audit reference for a reviewed action.
